![New York Comic Con, Javits Center, Hells Kitchen, Manhattan](https://www.nyctourism.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2F1aemqu6a6t65%2F17CyrA8Zg34TTRSliERTDv%2F53645da0d4d285f765a6fad38ee6e897%2FComiccon-javits-Hells-Kitchen-Manhattan-NYC-photo-Christopher-Postlewaite.jpg%3Fw%3D1200%26q%3D75%26fm%3Dwebp%26fit%3Dfill%26f%3Dcenter&w=3840&q=75)
New York Comic Con. Photo: Christopher Postlewaite 
**[**New York Comic Con**](http://newyorkcomiccon.com/)
With geek culture having established an undeniable influence over mainstream entertainment, Comic Con at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center gains more and more ground. Expect to see lots of cosplayers, who provide plenty to gawk at, even if you don’t hit the fest’s many booths, panels and screenings. 
[](https://www.nyctourism.com/events/new-york-comic-con)![A person in an ornate red wig and elaborate historical costume holds a decorated book, posing at a lively convention center with cosplayers and colorful banners in the background.](https://www.nyctourism.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2F1aemqu6a6t65%2F2aCGE0hXUOHELHYynnL1uD%2Ff756838132965e98703581e1ac7d90ee%2FNYCC-Manhattan-NYC-Photo-Jason-Mendez.jpg&w=3840&q=75)
### [Comic Con](https://www.nyctourism.com/events/new-york-comic-con)
The 20th anniversary of Comic Con, held at the Javits Center, features a Coney Island theme along with the usual array of costumes and celebrities.
